Loss report: tekton -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/use/step/use-step-1 script.interpolation (no Concourse spelling for expression needs.version.outputs.tag; the line is replaced by a line that prints the loss and exits 1)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/version job.outputs (a Tekton result is written by a script line, which Concourse does not read; the output has no value)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/version/step/tag step.script (the line writes a Tekton result file, which Concourse does not read; the write goes to /dev/null)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci trigger.tag: tag twin of each job (a job cannot wait on a branch push and on a tag, because a tag resource has no version on a push; each job has a twin named <job>-tag that follows the tag resource, and the twin of a needed job feeds the twin that needs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/use/step/use-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
